title: Who buys Oahu: 2023-2025 recorded sales joined to the current owner roll's first-owner mailing address

sales.description: Moku oahu-sales.json: {13-digit key = county digit '1' + 12-digit TMK incl. 4-digit CPR suffix: [[price, date], ...]}, last two recorded sales per parcel; 110,127 parcels; latest sale date 2025-09-26; no 2026-dated sales.

owner_roll_structured.name: HoLIS CadastralTables OWNDAT (layer 6): taxbillstate / taxbillcountry / taxbillzip5, dataLastEdit 2026-10-05

calibration.name: Title Guaranty of Hawaii Buyer Statistics, Oahu (Q4 2024, Q2 2025, Q4 2025, Q1 2026, Q2 2026 editions) as parsed in an/new/tg.json

method: 1. SALES: every recorded sale dated 2023-01-01 or later with price >= $50,000 (12,513 parcel-sale records; 4 sub-$50K dropped). The sales-file key is 13 digits (county '1' + 12-digit TMK); the leading '1' is stripped to match the roll's 12-digit parid.

2. DEDUPE: parcel-sale records are grouped by (price, date, first 8 digits of the 12-digit TMK = zone+section+plat+parcel) and counted once (16 multi-parcel groups). Second pass: groups in different TMK8s with the same price, date AND identical current-owner mailing address are merged as one portfolio deal (25 merged; 17 of them >= $3M).

3. CURRENT-BUYER RULE: a deal is kept only if, for at least one of its parcels, it is the parcel's most recent recorded sale (so the current first-listed owner is that buyer). 154 deals resold later were dropped (124 of them 2023 sales).

4. OWNER ADDRESS: first-listed owner = OWNINFO ownseq 0 (Fee Owner preferred over Condo/Co-op Master). Origin comes from OWNDAT structured taxbillstate/taxbillcountry/taxbillzip5 when present (96.6% of analyzed deals); otherwise the OWNINFO free-text last address line is parsed (state+ZIP, country keywords, Canadian postcodes), falling back to the first OWNMLT fee-owner address when ownseq 0 is blank (never lessees). On deals where both exist, category agreement is 100% and US state/ZIP agreement 100% (country 191/192).

5. CLASSES: Hawaii split into Oahu ZIP (968xx + 19 Oahu 967xx ZIPs) vs neighbor-island ZIP; mainland_us = 49 other states + DC (metro by approximate USPS ZIP3 map); foreign by country; US territories (GU, AS, MP, FM, MH, PW, PR) and military APO/FPO (AA/AE/AP) are separate small buckets. For TG comparison territory+military are added to 'other US'.

6. INSTITUTIONAL: a deal whose current owner mailing address (normalized OWNINFO address lines) is shared by >= 10 non-master Oahu parcels on the current roll is set aside and reported separately (161 housing deals, 57 addresses).

7. HOUSING SAMPLE (all micro-market cuts): dominant ASMTPITT class 1 (inferred Residential) parcels, plus class 7 (inferred Hotel & Resort) CPR units. 259 commercial/industrial/agricultural/preservation/whole-hotel deals are excluded from the cuts but kept in 'all_property_*' for calibration (they distort $10M+ figures, e.g. a $499M resort sale).

8. TYPE: condo = every parcel in the deal has CPR suffix != '0000'; house = suffix '0000' (includes vacant residential lots). Supplementary condo split: TMK8 with >= 5 CPR units on the roll ('condo building') vs 2-4 units (mostly CPR'd house/duplex lots).

9. GEOGRAPHY: TMK zone = first digit of the 12-digit TMK; Waikiki = zone 2 section 6. Situs ZIP from LEGDAT (parcel match 98%; otherwise the modal ZIP of the same TMK8; 43 deals unmatched); ZIPs with >= 40 analyzed deals are shown.
10. SHARES are of deals with a classifiable owner address (33 deals with no usable address excluded). Dollar shares weight by deal price. Cells with n < 20 carry small_cell_n_lt_20 = true.
notes: NO 2026: oahu-sales.json has no sale after 2025-09-26, and 2025 is thin after April (1,905 deals vs TG 11,097), so '2026 YTD' cannot be measured from this join. The only 2026 figure available is TG Oahu Jan-Jun 2026: Hawaii 82.6%, other US 13.5%, foreign 3.9% of 5,026 sales.

COVERAGE: deals in the sales file equal 53% (2023), 48% (2024) and 17% (2025) of Title Guaranty's Oahu sale counts. The file is not a complete transaction record. In particular, developer closings in new towers are largely missing: 9557 CPR units created since late 2023 are on the roll but only 515 have any sale in the file.

CALIBRATION 2025: our 2025 housing mix (n=1796, excl. institutional) is Hawaii 83.9% / other US 14.0% / foreign 2.1% vs TG Oahu 2025 82.9% / 13.9% / 3.2% (derived counts 9,202 / 1,539 / 356 of 11,097; the brief's 13.8% / 3.3% differ from these by 0.1 pt through rounding). Gap = +1.0 / +0.2 / -1.1 pts. 2024, the most complete year (n=4973, 48% coverage), shows a larger gap: +3.7 / -2.1 / -1.6 pts. 2023: +2.9 / -1.2 / -1.4 pts against TG's published integer shares.

DIRECTION OF BIAS: in every year the join puts more buyers in 'Hawaii' (+1 to +4 pts) and fewer in 'foreign' (-1.1 to -1.6 pts) than TG. The near-match for full-year 2025 is partly coincidence: our 2025 deals are mostly January-April closings, and the like-for-like January-June 2025 comparison gives a gap of +2.1 / -1.3 / -0.8 pts. Use TG for island-level levels; use this join for differences between micro-markets (tier, type, zone, ZIP), which TG does not publish.

CAUSE 1, SALES-FILE SELECTION (foreign shortfall, partly measured): the non-institutional owners of the new CPR units missing from the sales file (n=2963) are 4.3% foreign, against 2.1% in the joined sales. In TMK zone 2 (Kakaako/Ala Moana/Waikiki) they are 13.4% foreign and 12.9% mainland. In the Honolulu districts (TMK zones 1-3) our 2024 foreign share is 3.2% vs TG 6.1%. A rough what-if that adds these owners to the 2023-2025 joined deals raises foreign from 2.1% to 2.4%, so missing developer closings explain part (about 0.3 pt) of the 1.1-1.6 pt foreign shortfall. It would raise Hawaii too, so it does not explain the Hawaii overstatement. The make-up of the other ~half of TG transactions missing from the file is unknown.

CAUSE 2, MAILING-ADDRESS LAG OR DRIFT BY RELOCATING BUYERS (likely main cause of the Hawaii overstatement, inferred): TG classifies a buyer by the address at closing, while the roll shows today's bill-to address. Mainland households that move to Oahu, such as military and job transfers, are 'US buyers' to TG but 'Hawaii' here once they live in the home. Consistent with this, the other-US shortfall shows up in the owner-occupant suburbs: Leeward+Central (TMK zones 7-9) -3.0 pts in 2024 and -2.0 in 2025, and Windward+North Shore (zones 4-6) -3.1 in 2024 and -7.2 in 2025 (n=216). It does not show up in urban Honolulu (zones 1-3: -1.0 and +4.0), where TG's extra foreign buyers dominate the gap. The gap does not grow with time since purchase (2023 +2.9, 2024 +3.7, 2025 +1.0 pts Hawaii), which fits a change of address at move-in rather than slow drift. The roll (2026-10-05) is more than 12 months newer than the latest sale, so unprocessed deeds should not matter.

CAUSE 3, TRUSTS / LLCs / AGENTS / BILL-TO-UNIT: owners who send the tax bill to a Hawaii trustee, attorney, property manager or the unit itself count as 'Hawaii'. Of 2023-24 Hawaii-address buyers of class-1 condos, 41% carry no exemption of any kind (investors, or absentee owners using a local address). For 77% of Oahu-address condo buyers the mailing ZIP equals the unit's ZIP. Owner names were not pulled, so trusts and LLCs cannot be identified directly. Shared institutional addresses (10+ parcels) cover only 1.3% of deals and are 91% Hawaii-addressed; including or excluding them moves the shares by <= 0.3 pt, and thresholds of 5-50 parcels move them by <= 0.1 pt.

CAUSE 4, MULTI-PARCEL DEDUPE (negligible): parcel-level counts without any dedupe differ from deal-level shares by <= 0.1 pt in every year, and the all-property and housing samples differ by <= 0.1 pt. The 154 deals resold since purchase cannot be tested because their buyers are no longer on the roll.

DEFINITIONS: TG does not publish how it treats territories or military addresses; here they are added to 'other US' (0.1-0.3%). TG Korea = 'Korea'. California is 53% of our 2024-25 mainland buyers vs 44% of TG's other-US buyers, and Japan is 63% of foreign vs TG 64%.
SMALL CELLS: $10M+ housing has only 14 deals (2023-2025) and luxury condos only 72, so treat their mixes as indicative. Any cell with n < 20 is flagged.

HOUSE vs CONDO caveat: a CPR suffix also covers CPR'd house lots. Only 209 of 8043 CPR-unit deals sit on TMKs with 2-4 units, so 'condo' here is essentially apartment condos. Tax-class labels are inferred because the layer publishes no lookup table.
METROS use an approximate hand-built USPS ZIP3 -> metro map (from pull/owners_oahu/build.py), not an official CBSA crosswalk.
PRIVACY: the output holds aggregate counts and shares only. No owner names (not pulled), street addresses, parcel IDs or TMK8s are included. Institutional addresses are reported only as counts.

2026_ytd.note: No 2026-dated sales exist in oahu-sales.json (latest recorded sale 2025-09-26); 2026 YTD cannot be measured from this join. TG Oahu Jan-Jun 2026 is in calibration_vs_title_guaranty.

what_if_missing_new_unit_owners_added_to.caveat: rough what-if: mixes periods (units created Oct 2023 - Oct 2026) and assumes each missing unit owner is one missing deal

new_construction_cpr_units_since_2023_ch.note: Owners of CPR units created since late 2023 are mostly first buyers from developers; no sale price/date is available for them in oahu-sales.json, so they cannot be tiered or dated. Their non-institutional owner mix is shown only to test whether developer closings missing from the sales file skew foreign.
